lines.text: Yes, you can build software today without tech expertise.
lines.reason: Acknowledges the initial claim that AI lowers the barrier to building software.

lines.text: The point I am coming to folks, is that the barrier is a factor but it is not the ultimate factor.
lines.reason: Introduces the core argument that the barrier is not the ultimate factor.

lines.text: And who knows maybe that 1% is the difference between your business surviving or getting washed away.
lines.reason: Highlights the critical importance of the 1% of problems for business survival.

lines.text: But when you have built the thing and you are running the thing, you will run into the 1% problems.
lines.reason: Explains when the 1% problems will inevitably arise.

lines.text: And yeah that’s when you’ll need Tech, and that’s when you’ll need humans.
lines.reason: Concludes that tech expertise and humans are essential for addressing the critical 1%.
